title: Teleshopping
desc: Learn about a wide selection of products and take advantage of a convenient method of shopping. A show for those who love to shop from the comforts of their home.

title: Unakkaagave Vaazhgiren
desc: Ravi Shankar, a musician, grief-stricken by a tragedy, meets Chitra, a woman who shares a similar story like him, which makes him realise he is responsible for her misery.

title: Sakthivel
desc: An honest cop, Sakthivel, clashes with a powerful politician's son. Later, he is promoted and sent to a remote village where he uncovers a deeper corruption that puts his principles to the test.

title: Chinnappadass
desc: Chinnappadas, a law professor, loses his job after beating up thugs who harass his sister. However, things take a turn for the worse when his wife dies while trying to escape a rape attempt.

title: Johnny
desc: Johnny loves Archana, a singer, but their lives are disrupted when Johnny's lookalike kills his lover for infidelity and tries to pin the blame on Johnny. He also takes refuge in Archana's house.

title: Padikkadavan
desc: Rocky, a school dropout, falls for Gayathri, a wealthy woman, but must confront her gangster father and overcome societal prejudices to prove his worth.
